## National Technology Day

News Date : 11 May 2023News ReportThe National Technology Day was celebrated on 11th May 2023 with a series of events and activities. The achievements and innovations of Indian scientists and engineers in the field of technology and software were briefly addressed by the Principal, Vice-principal, senior faculty members and other Heads of the departments. The events were attended by 900 students and staff, where topics such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, cyber security, blockchain, robotics, and many more were discussed. The participants learned about the latest trends and developments in domains of latest technologies, tools and platforms. The day was a great learning experience for the students and staff, who gained insights and skills in the emerging technologies and software.
